messages.text: Please sketch an itinerary for the Sunday October 11, 2–2:30 pm PizzaLab tasting. I’m still deciding whether to go.
For pizza, I avoid mushrooms; I’m fine with dairy.
Good to know.
Remember that ceramics break last week when we got pizza? I was all about the cheese and happily avoided the mushrooms.
Ha, yes—cheese in, mushrooms out for you. Pottery-break pizza memories are strong.
Very strong. I’ll defend that topping stance anytime.
Can I stay with you Friday October 9 through Monday October 12? Arrive about 4 pm Friday, leave 9 am Monday.
Yes, guest room is yours. I have meals out but you can let yourself in.
Our regular game is Wednesdays at 8 pm at my place. This week only, Thursday October 8 instead? Back to Wednesdays after that.
Thursday this week works.
Same here.
Your watercolor workshop is Tuesday October 6, 10–11 am at MR Hall.
Great, see you Tuesday.
The old application checklist was useful last month.
I’ll send you the revised checklist tomorrow.
Thanks. Could you also tell me the interview room?
Can you proofread my cover letter by Thursday evening?
I can do that.
Your bookings: pottery Wednesday October 7 at 10 am; framing Thursday October 8 at 10 am, both at our Oak studio.
Thanks, those are the two I booked.
Sorry, that appointment is cancelled.
Office party balloons have their own lighting budget apparently.
The snacks deserve representation.
Pizza Friday at 1, Rosa's on Oak Street? Leo, Tess, want in?
Yes, Friday works for me.
I can make it if my shift finishes early.
Also that trailer gave away the entire ending.
my homemade crust came out like cardboard, I’m done pretending I can do pizza night
ha, let’s just do pizza at Luigi’s on 5th Friday at 6. Just us?
yeah that works, just the two of us
Dinner Thursday October 8 at 7 pm at Juniper Cafe?
Thursday at 7 at Juniper works.
Friday works.
Great, see you then.
Sorry, I meant the Wednesday pottery booking. Thursday framing is still booked.
Thanks for clearing that up.
Could Friday lunch be noon instead?
Noon works. I’ll tell the others.
Maya and I just agreed noon instead for Friday.
Noon is good for me.
Shift got covered. I can come at noon too.
Rosa's is closed Friday. Same lunch, can we switch to Mario's on Pine Street?
Yes, Mario's.
Works for me.
Works for me too.
Room 204 for the interview.
Got it, thanks.
I’m still polishing the revised checklist, so I’ll send it once it’s ready.
MR Hall is Maple Ridge Hall. The old handout also lists a room over at ZX Annex.
You’re invited: Rae performs Sunday October 11 at 8 pm. Location shown after RSVP.
That office lunch last Thursday was actually decent—I skipped the creamy pasta since I avoid dairy, but the mushrooms were good.
Nice, good to know.
Yeah, and for the record, friends call me AC. Work email says Alex Chen, but AC is fine.
Nora is joining too. I invited her to our Friday lunch and she said yes to noon at Mario’s.
Great, add Nora to the table.
New shift landed. I can’t make Friday lunch after all.
We’ll miss you. Lunch is still on.
I’m still coming.

Could we move dinner to Saturday October 10? Same time and place.

On Monday you wrote:
> Thursday at 7 at Juniper works.
Yes, Saturday instead.

Actually 12:30 Friday would be better. Same place we agreed yesterday.

On Monday October 5, Maya wrote in the group:
> Pizza Friday at 1, Rosa's on Oak Street? Leo, Tess, want in?
12:30 works.
Me too.
I’m still out, sorry.
Nora says 12:30 works too; I just texted her.
Here’s the revised checklist: ID, printed portfolio, two references. That’s the complete new version.
Received, thanks.
Correction to what I said Monday: mushrooms are fine now. Please avoid dairy for me from now on.
Got it, no dairy for you.
For me, dairy-free just through Sunday October 11 inclusive. I haven’t decided about after that.
Venue announcement: Rae’s Sunday October 11 concert will be at Foundry Theatre, 8 pm.
I’m still on the fence about Rae’s show Sunday. Want to come with me if I end up going?
maybe, depends if my shift ends early. I won’t know till closer to the weekend.
fair. I’ll let you know if I decide to go.
sounds good. Hope her set’s good either way.
Parcel 381 will arrive Friday. Driver recruitment webinar: https://example.org/drivers .
I also booked a parcel-support video call Friday at 9. What is its link?
I don’t have your support-call link yet.
This week’s listings: Pizza social, North Hall, Friday at 12:30. Tickets available at the door.
I’ve decided: I will attend the PizzaLab tasting Sunday October 11, 2–2:30 pm. Want to join?
Not for me, thanks.
Sorry, childcare fell through. I’m out for Friday.
Nora just cancelled with me too. Then it’s just you and me for lunch now.
Yes, just the two of us.
Could we do tomorrow instead of Saturday?
Not Friday. Saturday is still good.
Saturday it is. What about trying North Cafe someday?
Maybe someday, not this dinner.

Hi,

Can I return your drill on Sunday, October 11 at 3 pm at your door?

Thanks,
Ben

Hi Ben,

Yes, Sunday at 3 pm at my door works. See you then.

Thanks
I missed Tuesday’s watercolor workshop after all. Please send the notes.
Will do.
Could Alex Reed join our game tonight?
Yes, the Thursday game with Maya at my place, 8. Tell him.
I’ll ask him; don’t count him until he answers.
Here’s your parcel-support call link for tomorrow at 9: https://example.org/parcel381 .
Found my certificate from the workshop on January 2, 2024.
Nice, that’ll be useful for the interview.
For interview prep, can we call next Thursday—October 15—at 10 am?
Yes, October 15 at 10 works.
Finished proofreading your cover letter. The only fix I’d make is the company name in paragraph two—it’s wrong there.
Got it, thanks. I’ll correct that.
Settled into your guest room, thanks. Tomorrow I’m leaving at 8 for a museum, back about 5. My bag stays here.
Enjoy. The room is yours for the rest of the stay.
Your refund for the pottery class cancelled Wednesday October 7 has been issued.

Clearing out Monday’s notes:
> For pizza, I avoid mushrooms; I’m fine with dairy.
Back from the museum. Train changed: I’ll finish my stay Sunday October 11 at 10 am instead of Monday.
Okay, Sunday at 10 then.
I can’t host the weekly games anymore. Let’s end the series now, including October 14.
Understood, no more weekly game bookings.
Understood too.
Want to do coffee Tuesday at Birch? I can meet at 8 am.
Yeah, that works—8 am at Birch. I’ll keep it quick before the day starts.
Perfect. I’ll try not to relive the ceramics break over coffee.
Pizza Friday October 16 at 1 at Mario's on Pine Street, just us?
Yes, next Friday at 1, just us.
Still not sure whether I’ll keep avoiding dairy after tonight.
Let me know when you decide.
Nora booked Luigi’s on 5th for Friday October 9 at 6 too. Her guest list was just herself and her flatmates Eli and Jo.
Want to try the climbing wall Wednesday October 14 at 6 pm? No rush to answer.
That spaceship model looked better than the digital version.
Still couldn’t forgive the ending.
Fair. Practical effects deserved a better script.
